arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translation: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will be rewarded according to their intention.
The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it to others.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
translation: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands the Muslims are safe.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.

arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
